run_onnx_upscale_pipeline_default_ddpm: run the ONNX stable diffusion upscale pipeline with the default DDPM scheduler on CPU
run_onnx_upscale_pipeline_pndm: run the ONNX stable diffusion upscale pipeline with the PNDM scheduler for image upscaling
run_onnx_upscale_pipeline_dpm_multistep: run the ONNX stable diffusion upscale pipeline with the DPM multistep scheduler
run_onnx_upscale_pipeline_euler: run the ONNX stable diffusion upscale pipeline with the Euler discrete scheduler
run_onnx_upscale_pipeline_gpu_lms: run the ONNX stable diffusion upscale pipeline on GPU with the LMS scheduler
